title: The Offside Trap — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Spanish French language learning trilingual football
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The offside trap is a collective act of confidence
Eleven men stepping forward at exactly the same moment
Trusting that none of them will flinch

[Verse 2 — Español]
Solo funciona si todos creen en ello [It only works if everyone believes in it]
Un hombre que duda [One man who hesitates]
Un hombre que se queda medio segundo atrás [One man who stays back half a second]
Y la trampa se convierte en un regalo [And the trap becomes a gift]
Un regalo hermoso y costoso [A beautiful, expensive gift]

[Chorus — English]
The offside trap says — we are one unit
The offside trap says — we move together
The offside trap says — step, now, together
One second later — the trap has either worked or it hasn't

[Bridge — Français]
Chas regardait le hors-jeu depuis les tribunes pendant quarante ans [Chas watched the offside trap from the stands for forty years]
Il disait — fils, c'est la chose la plus optimiste du football [He said — son, it's the most optimistic thing in football]
Une défense de quatre qui se fait entièrement confiance [A back four that trusts each other completely]
C'est plus rare que ce qu'ils essaient d'arrêter [That's rarer than the thing they're trying to stop]

[Verse 3 — English]
The linesman's flag is the verdict
Up — the trap worked
Down — someone hesitated

[Outro — EN/ES/FR]
The offside trap
La trampa del fuera de juego [The offside trap]
Le hors-jeu [The offside trap]
That's my boy
